rows.grounds: fused accusative list of four emblems
present indicative of bhṛ with sandhi

items.question: Which four emblems does the white-armed deity always bear in his hands?
premises: It says he bears them always.
items.inference: The deity is described as eternally bearing conch, disk, club, and lotus in his arms.
uncertainties: Fused token preserves sandhi; exact case of each emblem is not separately marked.
items.plain_english: He always bears conch, disk, club, and lotus with his arms.
